info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Carrental Reservations Pickup-v1-spec
info.description: The Car Rental Reservation Pickup API facilitates the creation of reservation pickups for customers planning to rent vehicles. By utilizing this endpoint, users can submit multiple pickup reservation requests efficiently, ensuring a streamlined process for both customers and rental agencies. This API is particularly useful for travel agencies, corporate clients, and customer service representatives who need to handle numerous rentals concurrently. With robust support for managing reservations, this API enhances operational efficiency and improves the customer experience in the car rental industry.

post.description: This operation allows users to create a new pickup reservation for their items. Specify the necessary details to initiate the reservation process.

requestBody.description: The request body for picking up a reservation. It contains the necessary details required to process a pickup request, including reservation ID, pickup location, and any special instructions. Ensure that all fields are correctly filled to avoid any issues during the pickup process.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the pickup reservation details are returned.
